##### Project general facts

Cove Grand by Imtiaz is a residential development that combines contemporary architecture with spacious layouts and a wide range of lifestyle amenities. The project is designed for residents who value comfort, calm surroundings and a strong connection to nature, creating a welcoming environment for families and professionals alike.

Residents have access to a grand lobby, a swimming pool and outdoor areas for exercise and relaxation. Green parks, open spaces and shaded walkways are integrated into the landscape, offering space for walks, family time and outdoor activities in a peaceful setting.

The apartments are finished with modern, high-quality materials and are equipped with an Alexa smart home system. Kitchens come equipped with appliances and fittings by Siemens and Vitra. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalise the interiors to their taste.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Dubailand, a large and diverse community in Dubai that combines residential neighbourhoods with entertainment and leisure destinations. The area offers a quieter suburban setting while remaining connected to the rest of the city.

Dubailand is home to a variety of leisure attractions suitable for residents and visitors of all ages, including Global Village, one of the city's best-known seasonal entertainment destinations. These attractions make the area especially appealing for families with children.

The community also offers a range of sports facilities and outdoor spaces, including golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks and large parks. This makes Dubailand a convenient choice for residents who enjoy an active lifestyle and spending time outdoors.
